lead.jd_excerpt: Key Responsibilities Lead the development of advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI-driven solutions to address business challenges and generate actionable insights. Design, develop, and implement AI products, including applications leveraging Agentic AI frameworks for practical business use cases. Build and maintain agents and applications powered by AI, taking solutions from proof-of-concept to production. Design, develop, and implement software solutions across frontend and backend systems, incorporating cloud application and data architecture principles. Improve development and workflows through automation, reusable components, tooling, and standardized technical engineering practices. Conduct comprehensive functional and performance testing using a range of techniques, agents and tools to ensure high-quality solution delivery. Collaborate with technology teams on cloud-based agent and application architecture, design, and implementation. Analyse business requirements and recommend technology solutions using Agile delivery methodologies. Support the end-to-end product lifecycle, including roadmap planning, development, testing, deployment, and continuous enhancement. Define non-functional requirements and assess database solutions in compliance with relevant regulations. Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of products and solutions and identify opportunities to apply AI and automation in the business. Job Requirement Relevant experience in Agentic AI engineering, web application development, data science, or related disciplines. Knowledge of AI techniques, including hands-on experience developing and implementing skills, harnesses, MCPs, Agentic AI frameworks in practical applications. Familiarity with AI tools, frameworks, and open-source libraries relevant to the field. Knowledge of database design, implementation, and management. Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and cloud computing platforms and services. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex business problems into effective technology solutions. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams and explain technical concepts to diverse audiences. Experience with commercial AI, workflow, data and data science platforms such as n8n, Northflank, Copilot in Power Automate, Dataiku, Databricks, Snowflake, etc; or Wh
